issues.title: Incorrect total transactions calculation
issues.problem: The subquery is incorrectly calculating total transactions for each merchant by using a correlated subquery, which is inefficient and incorrect.
issues.fix: Remove the subquery and use COUNT(*) directly.

issues.title: Inefficient correlated subquery
issues.problem: Using a correlated subquery can be very inefficient as it re-runs for each row.
issues.fix: Remove the subquery and use COUNT(*) directly.

issues.title: Alias consistency
issues.problem: The query uses both uppercase and lowercase aliases inconsistently.
issues.fix: Use consistent casing for aliases (e.g., always lowercase).

review.corrected_sql: SELECT m.merchant_name, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM fact_transactions t JOIN dim_merchant m ON t.merchant_id = m.merchant_id GROUP BY m.merchant_name ORDER BY txn_count DESC;
review.summary: The query had a correctness issue with the total transactions calculation and used an inefficient correlated subquery. It also had readability issues with inconsistent alias casing.
